niche.habitat: Ice veneer, shallow fractures, ejected regolith. Also, in the council's sketch (no such creature in this world yet): Coraza Peregrina, ceniza Roja aggregates within the Coraza's sheltered core; the Coraza provides magnetic navigation and superior shielding, carrying Ceniza to worlds the surface cannot reach alone.
niche.diet: Radiolytic redox couples in ice lattice; chemolithotrophy upon landing
niche.active: Cryptobiotic stasis >99.99% of time; brief activation during flyby heat or landing

body: Filamentous mat of ether-linked lipids embedded with melanin-like pigment grains and trehalose glass; forms spherical 'tuns' that detach as propagules

links: Prevents high-LET ionization tracks from shattering helices
Unshielded cosmic rays deliver lethal doses even in vacuum

skill.effect: Its dark armor grains absorb harsh cosmic radiation, keeping its genetic material intact during long journeys. You see the creature withstand extreme space conditions without deteriorating.

chains.weakness: Melanin saturation. After ~500 years of unshielded exposure, accumulated damage outpaces repair; lineage must land in a shielded niche or risk extinction.
observe: Propagules detaching in straight lines without wind

journal.en: Ash that flies. The wind is dead; only the straight line matters.

plausibility.summary: Reframe as strong reduction of secondary (radiolytic) damage and UV, not linear-energy-transfer track dose; pair with shallow burial in the ice veneer or symbiotic shielding from Coraza Peregrina; cap unshielded drift before saturation (~0.8 Sv/y from F8) to match the 500-year weakness.
fixes: Reframe as strong reduction of secondary (radiolytic) damage and UV, not linear-energy-transfer track dose; pair with shallow burial in the ice veneer or symbiotic shielding from Coraza Peregrina; cap unshielded drift before saturation (~0.8 Sv/y from F8) to match the 500-year weakness.

analogues.organism: Melanized fungi (e.g. Cryptococcus neoformans) and radiotolerant melanized fungi—melanin binds radicals and modulates damage; tardigrades add DNA repair and vitrification, not pigment alone.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Allows ejection by tiny outgassing torques and microgravity
Surface grains escape at velocities near thermal kinetic energy

skill.effect: It releases a lightweight silica-ice seed that drifts through the void toward a nearby world. You can guide it to follow the natural flow of space, increasing its chances of reaching the destination.

chains.weakness: Requires trigger. Propagules only eject during chaotic tumbling events or transient outgassing; player must wait for spin state changes.
observe: Seeds floating upward against negligible gravity

journal.en: The world shakes, and the seeds wake to ride the spin.

plausibility.summary: Treat Ballistic Seed as same-nucleus or same-swarm ejection (regolith across fractures, between tumbling faces); reserve interstellar success bonuses to the Coraza symbiosis or rare flyby outburst windows; drop or soften ly-scale targeting unless velocity and encounter geometry are explicit.
fixes: Treat Ballistic Seed as same-nucleus or same-swarm ejection (regolith across fractures, between tumbling faces); reserve interstellar success bonuses to the Coraza symbiosis or rare flyby outburst windows; drop or soften ly-scale targeting unless velocity and encounter geometry are explicit.

analogues.organism: Comet nucleus outgassing and dust jets (67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko-style non-gravitational forces); porous refractory–ice aggregates in Oort-cloud bodies.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Signals safe landing zones and colony aggregation in straight lines
No turbulence or plume formation in hard vacuum

skill.effect: It releases a strong chemical scent that marks a specific location in the environment. Allied creatures immediately detect the signal and rush toward the marked spot.

chains.weakness: Line-of-sight only. Signal blocks if an obstacle (asteroid, moon) intercepts the straight path.
observe: Crystal shards releasing vapor that hangs motionless
Units aligning instantly to vapor line

journal.en: A whisper that travels forever until it strikes.

plausibility.summary: Limit Direct Signal to (1) shallow fractures with adsorbed/brine films during flyby or landing activation, or (2) co-released sublimates that form a short-lived, confined vapor sheet; allies respond by tun rupture and passive roll/detachment along the flux gradient, not sprinting in vacuum. Keep line-of-sight blocking as stated.
fixes: Limit Direct Signal to (1) shallow fractures with adsorbed/brine films during flyby or landing activation, or (2) co-released sublimates that form a short-lived, confined vapor sheet; allies respond by tun rupture and passive roll/detachment along the flux gradient, not sprinting in vacuum. Keep line-of-sight blocking as stated.

analogues.organism: Bacterial quorum sensing works in liquid films, not ISM vacuum; insect pheromones require a continuous atmosphere—here the honest analogue is brief volatile release in a transient sublimate micro-shroud (F12).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Suspends metabolism for millennia during energy gaps
Radiolytic fuels and solvents are scarce and patchy

skill.effect: It encases itself in a hard, glass-like shell and falls into a deep dormant state. You see the creature become completely impervious to extreme cold and radiation, though it must shed some mass to awaken.

chains.weakness: Slow recovery. Takes 50 years of radiolytic recharge to restore full biomass after waking; vulnerable during this period.
observe: Glow fading as chemical bonds lock
Resuming activity only near brine seep

journal.en: Sleep is the only travel. The void is long.

plausibility.summary: Optional honesty tweak: change 'immune' for 10,000 years to 'metabolically suspended; radiation and cold tolerant with greatly reduced active damage; total dose and repair cost still bind long drift'—gameplay numbers can stay if framed as relative resistance.

body_plan.origin: Grows as a continuous surface veneer; breaks into units via mechanical stress or radiolytic oxidation

temperament: Passive, opportunistic; triggers ejection only when radiation dose or outgassing torque reaches threshold
secrets: Injecting radiation accelerates melanin production but risks saturation; player can 'over-shield' a lineage to extend drift range at the cost of eventual repair need.
Ballistic signals can be hijacked by placing a reflective ice shard; the signal bounces, misleading allies to barren worlds.
moments: A million red specks lift off the ice as the nucleus tumbles, drifting like a reverse aurora toward the dark, each one a universe waiting to wake.

journal.en: Ash that flies. The wind is dead; only the straight line matters.
Sleep is the only travel. The void is long.
